//: Local dev only. These are the throwaway credentials from docker-compose.yml and the demo device's token — hashed into a real device row by the seed command, and guarding nothing but a laptop; no real secret is ever committed. Set Storage__PublicEndpoint when the phone reaches MinIO through a tunnel rather than at localhost. The Azure and Anthropic keys are NOT here and never will be — they live in user-secrets (see README / dotnet user-secrets set).
//auth: AppUrl is where the PWA is served from. The invite mail builds its set-password link against it, so with this empty the mail is not sent at all — AdminInviteJob refuses to post a bare token nobody can use, and says so in the log rather than sending something useless.
//reporting: Mailpit from docker-compose.yml: it accepts anything on localhost:1025 and shows every message at http://localhost:8025. Nothing here leaves the laptop, which is the point — the whole PDF-and-email path is provable before any relay account exists. A real relay replaces Smtp.Host/Port/Security/Username/Password and nothing else.
//hangfire: No dashboard credentials locally: with none configured the dashboard serves loopback requests only, which is exactly the laptop case. A staging box must set Hangfire__DashboardUser and Hangfire__DashboardPassword or the dashboard stays unreachable.
